messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete playable 3D story-mode first-person shooter inspired by Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, with realistic-looking guns and physics, for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- User requested “insane graphics above 1gb apk file” and specified “3D Game, Phone/Tablet.”
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-playable Three.js campaign prototype, “BLACK TIDE — Nightfall Protocol,” rather than an Android APK; no APK packaging or 1 GB asset build was created.
- Built original procedural scenery, enemies, and a first-person rifle without external game assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with mission briefing, HUD, pause/result screens, and mobile controls.
- Created `styles.css` with cinematic campaign presentation and responsive mobile/tablet layouts.
- Created `game.js` implementing a Three.js compound, custom weapon, five hostiles, movement/collision, aiming, shooting, reloads, damage, and mission completion.
- Ran `node --check game.js` successfully.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and opened it with Playwright.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/black-tide.jpg` and `screenshots/black-tide-play.jpg`.
- Made follow-up code adjustments to hide the weapon until gameplay, resize/reposition it, and track mobile touch aim using pointer deltas.

### Active
- Validate the latest edits in browser, including mobile aiming and gameplay; rerun syntax check and inspect the latest screenshot.
- Communicate scope honestly: the current build is a lightweight browser game, not a 1 GB APK.

### Blocked
- No APK build tooling or native Android project was created; the requested APK size/format remains unmet.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and browser smoke tests after the latest edits.
2. Test deploy, pause/resume, mobile controls, reload, combat, and mission completion; fix any issues.
3. Provide a concise completion note explaining that the playable web prototype is implemented and APK packaging/1 GB assets were not produced.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game entry page, HUD, campaign and result screens.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive touch controls.
- `game.js`: Three.js renderer, game scene, combat and controls.
- `screenshots/black-tide.jpg`: Earlier campaign-screen capture.
- `screenshots/black-tide-play.jpg`: Gameplay capture from before latest weapon sizing changes.

## Important Context
- Playwright launched the site at `http://localhost:3002`; initial browser console reported a missing `/favicon.ico`, later addressed by adding an inline favicon in `index.html`.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.164.1/build/three.module.js`; internet access is required.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build a playable 3D story-mode first-person shooter inspired by Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare for phones and tablets.
- User requested “insane graphics above 1gb apk file” and specified “3D Game, Phone/Tablet.”

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-playable Three.js campaign prototype, “BLACK TIDE — Nightfall Protocol,” rather than an Android APK.
- Used original procedural scenery, enemies, and a first-person rifle without external game assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `index.html` with mission briefing, HUD, pause/result screens, and mobile controls.
- Added `styles.css` with cinematic campaign presentation and responsive mobile/tablet layouts.
- Added `game.js` implementing the Three.js scene, weapon, five hostiles, movement/collision, aiming, shooting, reloads, damage, and mission completion.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser loaded the page, and the latest console check reported no errors.
- Captured and inspected JPEG screenshots, including `screenshots/black-tide-latest.jpg`.
- Fixed mobile touch-aim pointer-delta tracking and rounded health display.

### Active
- Validate gameplay in browser: pause/resume, mobile controls, reload, combat, and mission completion; fix any issues.
- Recheck syntax and inspect the latest screenshot after further changes.

### Blocked
- No native Android project or APK packaging was created; the requested APK format and 1 GB asset build remain unmet.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser smoke tests, especially pause/resume and gameplay controls.
2. Fix issues found, then rerun `node --check game.js` and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot.
3. Report the web prototype’s scope honestly, including that it is not a 1 GB APK.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game entry page, HUD, campaign and result screens.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive touch controls.
- `game.js`: Three.js renderer, game scene, combat and controls.
- `screenshots/black-tide-latest.jpg`: Most recent inspected screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Served locally at `http://localhost:3002`; Three.js is loaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.164.1/build/three.module.js`, so internet access is required.
- Pause behavior is not fully validated: pressing Escape in the browser test left the pause screen hidden while pointer lock was active; manually calling `document.exitPointerLock()` caused the pause screen to appear.
